dct_title_s: Map showing the system of Rebel fortifications on the Mississippi River at Island No. 10 and New Madrid, also the operations of the U.S. forces under General John Pope against these positions
dct_alternative_sm: Map showing the system of Rebel fortifications on the Mississippi River at Island Number Ten and New Madrid, also the operations of the United States forces under General John Pope against these positions
dct_description_sm: Wm. Hoelcke, Captn. & Addl. A. de C. U.S.A.

Military map. Covers an area near New Madrid, Missouri on the Mississippi River. Shows infantry, naval and artillery positions, fortifications and movements. Also shows landowner names, vegetation, streams and roads.
Date of situation 1862 Apr. 7, the surrender of Mackall to Pope--cf. Boatner, Mark Mayo. Civil War Dictionary. NY: McKay, 1959, p. 588.
Date of ms. tentatively based on date of situation.
Pen-and-ink (black and color) on tracing cloth.
Official atlas of the Civil War. NY: Thomas Yoseloff, 1958, pl. 10, no. 1.
